pr_title: Fix `--generate-mono-glue` printing an unknown CLI argument warning
pr_body:
- Follow-up to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/98895.

___

- Abort with an error when using `--generate-mono-glue` on builds without C# support (similar to `--test` on builds with tests disabled).
- Fix unknown CLI argument warning messages not being visible on Windows.
- Fix `--test` error message not being visible on Windows on builds with tests disabled.

The issue about prints not being visible is due to how `ERR_PRINT()` and `WARN_PRINT()` work. We don't need their stack trace to be visible here anyway. We can reinstate the coloring later in a future PR (which will apply to all CLI arguments by adding a new method for it).

- This closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/99069.

issue_context.title: Fail to build mono glue
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- Tested in 0f5f3bc9546b46b2029fc8896dc859697f1eab97

### System information

Windows 11 Pro

### Issue description

After the latest commits on godot (it used to build fine before that) the mono glue fails to be built with the following errors:
` Godot.SourceGenerators.Internal succeeded (1.3s) → glue\GodotSharp\Godot.SourceGenerators.Internal\bin\Debug\netstandard2.0\Godot.SourceGenerators.Internal.dll
  GodotSharp failed with 3 error(s) and 7 warning(s) (6.2s)
    D:\Source\Other\gd-engine\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharp\Compat.cs(35,12): error CS0246: The type or namespace name 'AnimationMethodCallMode' could not be found (are you missing a using directive or an assembly reference?)
    D:\Source\Other\gd-engine\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharp\Compat.cs(51,12): error CS0246: The type or namespace name 'AnimationProcessCallback' could not be found (are you missing a using directive or an assembly reference?)
    D:\Source\Other\gd-engine\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharp\Compat.cs(62,12): error CS0246: The type or namespace name 'AnimationProcessCallback' could not be found (are you missing a using directive or an assembly reference?)`
This is most surely caused by the new errors that popped in during the glue generation procedure which  are all as this following one:
`Cannot reference editor type 'EditorImportPlugin' in documentation for core type 'ImageTexture'
Generating ImageTexture3D.cs...
Generating ImageTextureLayered.cs...
ERROR: Cannot resolve method reference in documentation: 'Image.create'.
   at: BindingsGenerator::_append_xml_method (modules\mono\editor\bindings_generator.cpp:1151)`
This does happen quite a few times on other areas, like:
`ERROR: Cannot resolve method reference in documentation: 'Skeleton3D.clear_bones_global_pose_override'.
   at: BindingsGenerator::_append_xml_method (modules\mono\editor\bindings_generator.cpp:1151)`
and
`ERROR: Cannot resolve method reference in documentation: 'make_polygons_from_outlines'.
   at: BindingsGenerator::_append_xml_method (modules\mono\editor\bindings_generator.cpp:1151)
ERROR: Cannot resolve method reference in documentation: 'make_polygons_from_outlines'.
   at: BindingsGenerator::_append_xml_method (modules\mono\editor\bindings_generator.cpp:1151)
ERROR: Cannot resolve method reference in documentation: 'make_polygons_from_outlines'.
   at: BindingsGenerator::_append_xml_method (modules\mono\editor\bindings_generator.cpp:1151)`

### Steps to reproduce

Simply use latest commit to build from source with mono support, it will build the engine but fail to generate/build the mono glue.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Build issue.
comments: I'm unable to reproduce, please provide the commands you are using to build the engine.

I use this to build the engine, this works perfectly and it builds the binary 100% without any issues.

- set DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD_TO_PRERELEASE=1
- set /p SCRIPT_AES256_ENCRYPTION_KEY=<.keys\godot.gdkey
- scons platform=windows arch=x86_64 target=editor

Afterwards i do run this to do the mono glue part, which always worked, but now it errors on those spots with the errors i've shown:

- godot.windows.editor.x86_64.mono.exe --headless --generate-mono-glue modules/mono/glue
- python ./modules/mono/build_scripts/build_assemblies.py --godot-output-dir=./bin --push-nupkgs-local=%NUGET_PACKAGES%\..\sources

Edit: Also I noticed this at the beginning of the mono glue generation:
`WARNING: Unknown command line argument "--generate-mono-glue". User arguments should be passed after a -- or ++ separator, e.g. "-- --generate-mono-glue".`
Did the command for it change?
Edit²: I found out that the given error only happens when using `deprecated = "no"` on the `custom.py`, in case of using `deprecated = "yes"` the error does not occurs.

> I found out that the given error only happens when using `deprecated = "no"` on the `custom.py`, in case of using `deprecated = "yes"` the error does not occurs.

If you are building Godot without deprecated API, you also need to build the .NET assemblies without deprecated API (using the [`--no-deprecated`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/96570) flag). It doesn't look like you are doing that from the commands you listed, it should be something like this:

```
python ./modules/mono/build_scripts/build_assemblies.py --godot-output-dir=./bin --push-nupkgs-local=%NUGET_PACKAGES%..\sources --no-deprecated
```

> Also I noticed this at the beginning of the mono glue generation:
`WARNING: Unknown command line argument "--generate-mono-glue". User arguments should be passed after a -- or ++ separator, e.g. "-- --generate-mono-glue".`
Did the command for it change?

No, this is a false positive due to a recent change: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/98895 (cc @Calinou). It seems the command still works despite the warning.

I see, i did not know that, ill give a try right now and post the results.
Edit: I did try it, and it built with few warnings, so it works, but the generating of .cs files part stills gave the errors of things not being found in documentation, are there any flag for the .cs file generation script as well?

> The generating of .cs files part stills gave the errors of things not being found in documentation, are there any flag for the .cs file generation script as well?

Some documentation may reference deprecated API and the compiler will complain it can't find it. But these should be warnings, and can be safely ignored.

review_comments:
We're starting to accumulate a lot of hacks in `main.cpp` for the Mono module... I'm not fond of increasing the tech debt further here.

There's also `--class-db-json` in the Mono module that's not being handled here.

And basically any module that would want to "handle" a command line argument unique to itself by parsing `OS::get_cmdline_args` would have the same issue.

There are more:
```
modules/gdscript/tests/gdscript_test_runner_suite.h
44:             bool print_filenames = OS::get_singleton()->get_cmdline_args().find("--print-filenames") != nullptr;
45:             bool use_binary_tokens = OS::get_singleton()->get_cmdline_args().find("--use-binary-tokens") != nullptr;
```

I think it's better to go back to the drawing board for how to detect invalid arguments. We can't add special cases in `main.cpp` for all arguments parsed by first-party and third-party modules.

> There's also `--class-db-json` in the Mono module that's not being handled here.

I don't think anybody's using this, it's an undocumented option and could probably be replaced with `--dump-extension-api`.
